title: UAT 978 MHz: four aircraft and a ground station
description: tools/scene_five.json, 6 s looped: aircraft A1B2C3 (60 deg), A4D5E6 (150), a TIS-B-addressed glider ~5E08A6 (250), a vehicle ~ABC001 (320) and ground station site 11 (200 deg, uplink with a METAR + TIS-B). Positions at their compass bearings from the station (heading 0). Expect five talkers at those bearings.
